# Supplier Concentration Risk

## Purpose

Manage correlated risk when multiple important capabilities depend on the same supplier or underlying service chain.

## Assessment

Concentration SHOULD consider business criticality, data sensitivity, replacement lead time, geographic or infrastructure commonality, shared identity or network dependencies, subcontractors, and the feasibility of exit.

Multiple contracts do not create real diversification if they rely on the same underlying dependency.

## Treatment

Options include diversification, graceful degradation, local recovery capability, data portability, alternate suppliers, contractual protections, or explicit acceptance when alternatives are disproportionate.

## Review

Reassess after acquisitions, major supplier architecture changes, new critical workloads, incidents, or significant market changes.
